title: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy for Diabetic Wounds of Lower Extremities
description: CMS coverage for systemic hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) in patients with diabetic wounds of the lower extremities. Requires Wagner Grade 3 or higher, failure of at least 30 days of standard conservative wound therapy, and vascular evaluation.
scope_note: Curated benchmark criterion schema targeting primary statutory indications, exclusions, and waiting periods; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Severe Diabetic Wound Wagner Grade 3 or Higher
criteria.description: Documented deep diabetic foot ulceration with involvement of tendon, capsule, or bone (Wagner Grade 3: deep ulcer with abscess or osteomyelitis; Grade 4: gangrene of forefoot).
criteria.clinical_intent: Establish severe deep tissue infection or bone involvement

criteria.name: Failure of >= 30 Days Standard Conservative Wound Therapy
criteria.description: Patient must have completed at least 30 continuous days of standard wound care (including sharp debridement, moist dressings, and offloading) without measurable signs of healing.
criteria.clinical_intent: Verify exhaustion of standard wound care prior to high-cost HBOT

criteria.name: Lower Extremity Vascular Assessment
criteria.description: Documentation of peripheral perfusion assessment (palpable dorsalis pedis / posterior tibial pulses, or ABI >= 0.7) to rule out untreatable ischemic non-viability.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm sufficient vascular perfusion for tissue viability
